question: Which chapter is concluded as having issued forth in Candra-dvīpa?
premises: The text refers to an emergence in Candra-dvīpa.
A chapter is identified by an ordinal number.
The ninth chapter is named as that issued forth.
inference: The ninth chapter, issued forth in Candra-dvīpa, is concluded.
plain_english: Thus ends the ninth chapter, issued forth in Candra-dvīpa.
